Cook raw shrimps and chicken on the inn range. Classic first-skill AFK loop.
Bank-cook-bank with deposit-box adjacency. Constant clicking but fast.
Cook trout. Range + bank pattern. Burn rate reasonable.
Bakery's range is 1-tile from the bank chest. 1-tick deposit-withdraw-cook. Top 15+ XP.
Salmon on the open pier. Wind lowers range efficiency (5% burn) but that's the aesthetic.
During Storm Night event, ranges burn 2x hotter. Cook-speed-run with 0% burn if you time charms.
Mash grapes with a foot-press. Physical XP, no burn. Moderate attention.
The player-hosted roving market hosts ranges right on the fishing pier. Lobster-loop with zero banking distance.
Hosidius kitchen provides -5% burn. Rotation with adjacent bank. Quest-gated.
Swordfish on the pier. AFK, moderate burn, great profit.
Monkfish in the monastery kitchen. 0% burn at 62+ here.
Unfired pies + oven rotation. Pies bake with multi-step: pastry, add fish, bake. Multi-skill reliant.
Pour grape wines. Low cost, steady XP. Wines age overnight for +1 tier.
Communal stew cauldron. 7-ingredient mixes yield random-stat-boost stew.
Monastery shark-oven. 0% burn, AFK. The classic 80+ training.
Thatched-oven karambwan. Slightly higher burn than the monastery but materials are cheap.
6-burner range. 1-tick withdraw-cook-deposit. Top XP for 70s. Insane clicks.
Adjacent bank + 2-burner oven. Rotation press between bank and oven. Peak 80+ XP without pie chaining.
Anglerfish boil in the deep-pot. Slow but 0% burn.
Vent-boiled dark crabs. PK risk forces tight cooking. 10-minute sprints.
Bulk pour wines with 28-slot inventory. Wine ages automatically in inventory (+30% XP/hr vs walk).
Wool on spinning wheel. AFK.
Wheel + kiln rotation for clay pots. 2-step production.
Pay tanner for 27 tanned leather per trip. Pure AFK.
Make-X 28 leather bodies.
Glass beads via blowpipe. AFK if done with superheat magic nearby.
Cut sapphires for jewellery feed.
Emerald cutting. Feed for ring of dueling.
Green dhide vambraces. Peak make-X 32+.
Green dhide body. AFK slow loop.
Ruby cutting. AFK profitable.
Diamond cutting with make-X.
Blue dhide body AFK.
Dragonstone cutting. High value.
Red dhide body rotation. Peak 63+.
Red dhide body single-click AFK.
Black dhide body AFK.
Craft onyx amulets for fury upgrade. AFK profit.
Craft zenyte amulets/rings. AFK.
Industrial glass blowing. Tick-perfect pipe work.
Zenyte make-X chain. Peak 89+ XP.
Craft crystal tools for farming/mining. AFK multi-stage.
Sing crystals into shape. Multi-tone attunement. Endgame crafting capstone.
Burn logs along the road, walking 1 tile east. Classic FM introduction.
Drop logs on the central bonfire. +50% XP compared to the trail method.
Oak logs along the road. Standard trail burning.
Oak on central bonfire. Fastest 15+ XP.
During the storm-felling event, beach logs wash up every 15 seconds. Quick burns, high value.
Burn charred logs in a coal-smoke yard. Safe, slow, regional.
Burn willow logs along the harbor promenade.
Willow on bonfire. Dual with group members for +XP.
Alternate log-burn with cooking a salmon over the flame. Dual-XP skill stack.
Dreamwood-adjacent maple trail. The flames briefly hum in harmony.
Maple bonfire. The smoke shapes itself into half-real faces. Normal bonfire otherwise.
Yew logs. Glade-respecting. AFK.
Communal yew pyre. +20% XP when 3+ players share.
Magic logs on the blessed pyre. Pyre grants +50% XP. Quest-gated.
Triple pyre pattern — feed all three in rotation for +80% XP. Attention-intense.
Burn incense logs on a moryskah tomb pyre. Slow but gives prayer-ash (trade with priests).
Redwood pyre in the Wilderness. Redwood ash is a valuable reagent — worth the PK risk.
Light beacons across the Heartlands in a chain. Timer races: relight the chain before it dies. Quest-gated.
Burn petrified wood on the cemetery pyre. Ash is used in prayer potions.
Ironwood log burning. Yields iron-ash for smithing alloys.
Dreamwood pyre only burns when you whistle. Maintain tune while stacking logs.
Lazy shrimp and anchovy pools behind the mill. The water is warm and the fish are stupid. Beginner AFK.
Anchovy on bait with spot-hopping — the spot drifts every ~20 seconds so you must chase. Eats bait.
Bait fishing for sardines. Slow but brainless.
Drop-fish herring with rotation between three bait fishermen. All gp is sacrificed for pure XP.
Classic calm river flyfishing. Trout and salmon spawns alternate. Background-AFK baseline for the teens.
Flyfish trout at pool A, drop-click pool B, drop-click pool C. 3-tick drop-fishing. No bank, no gp, just XP.
Tick-manipulated pike harvest with drop-fishing rotation. Best 30+ XP. Competitive worlds.
Saltwater flyfishing for salmon. The sea breeze is nice. Modest attention, modest gp.
Caged lobsters around the player-hosted Drifting Market. Deeply AFK — the market NPCs will even cook them for a fee.
Skim brined mackerel from the shallow tide pools. Low attention but produces valuable Saltbrine food reagents.
Harpoon swordfish with trigger-timing on the strike animation. A miss wastes 4 seconds. Attention-hungry.
Tick-perfect drop-fish swordfish. All catches dropped. Pure XP.
Small school fish used as bait for karambwan. Quest-gated, AFK, but you will drown if you ignore the tide warnings.
Bait-harpoon karambwan in thunderfall. Uses 1 karambwanji per cast. Consistent even without perfect timing.
Monkfish with simple small-net casting. Heavy quest-gate but once unlocked, deeply AFK and excellent food.
Deep-water crab cages. 6-spot drift, background-grade AFK.
Sharks at the edge of the reef, two-spot drift. AFK, high profit, slow XP for level.
Drive sharks into the reef using admiral pie chum. High-XP, pie-drops mid-catch, requires tick-perfect pie usage.
Anglerfish lured with sandworms into a lasso trap. Profoundly AFK but burns sandworms — a hunter + cooking dependency.
Trawl dark crab nets in the deep Wilderness. Constant PK threat. 5x food value, stackable in the wilderness per Marstead.
Reality-warping koi that phase in and out. Silver net only catches them when visible. Easy rhythm but visuals mess with perception.
Stim-tonic unlocks micro-windows where dream koi are fully real. Tick-perfect netting + tonic refresh. Brutal but unmatched.
Tidal spawn event. Nets drift every 15 seconds. Exchange 40 minnow for 1 raw shark at the weighmaster (ironman loop).
Cut arrow shafts from logs. Low XP, extremely AFK.
Cut shortbow(u). Slightly more click cost than shafts.
String-bow rotation. 28 bows per inventory. Make-X dialogue.
Headless arrow assembly. Stack up for bolt tipping.
Make-X 28 headless arrows with a fast withdraw-fletch cycle.
Oak shortbow(u). Profit margin better than logs.
Oak bow stringing. 28 per batch. Peak 20-30.
Willow longbow cut. Dock breeze relaxes you.
Willow longbow rotation with make-X spam. Arms ache.
Steel dart assembly. AFK, profitable.
Make-X rotation with tight bank refills.
Maple longbow cut. Dream-flavored AFK.
Peak make-X efficiency at 50+.
Broad bolt tipping — slayer reagent. AFK multi-skill dependency.
Yew longbow(u) cut. AFK baseline for 65+.
Peak yew string rotation. Make-X for 28 bows.
Magic longbow(u). AFK quest-gated.
Peak XP method. Magic longbow stringing.
Adamant bolt tipping. AFK — single click per batch.
Dragon dart assembly. Make-X 1-tick chain.
Redwood shields. PK risk, high profit.
Bronze crossbow assembly — feeds the ranged bolt economy.
Dragon crossbow ornaments. Multi-step assembly — bench reagents in sequence.
Clean guam herbs in bulk. Classic AFK.
Attack potion mix. Make-X 14 per inventory.
Clean marrentill. Low XP, high AFK.
Tarromin clean. Veilwood-quiet.
Strength potion Make-X. Classic 12+ XP.
Harralander clean.
Energy potion rotation.
Defence potion Make-X.
Ranarr clean AFK. Core prayer potion feed.
Prayer potion Make-X. Top mid-game profit + XP.
Single-inventory Make. Pure AFK.
Ranging potion rotation for raids.
Super attack AFK.
Super combat assembly. 4-stage AFK.
Super strength AFK.
Super restore rotation. Max-profit mid-game.
Saradomin brew Make-X.
Overload assembly for raid meta.
Antivenom+ rotation.
Bone crush for prayer reagent. AFK.
Tap exposed copper veins in the sun-warmed outcrop outside Lumbrick. The ore almost flakes off the rock. Ideal AFK opener for the first five levels.
A tight two-rock tin formation that demands you hop between nodes. Slightly faster XP but you need to watch respawns.
A clustered quarry where you 3-tick between copper and tin rocks to keep the pick swinging every tick. Attention-intensive, but fastest pre-15 Mining.
Narrow seam of iron threading a collapsed industrial duct. The seam respawns slowly but constantly, so one click every few seconds is enough. Classic AFK iron.
Three iron rocks stacked in a triangle with staggered respawn timers. Tick-perfect rotations yield ~720 ore/hr. Bank 3 tiles away.
Soot-iron is a Sootworks-exclusive alloy ore. Slow-respawn linear vein, pure AFK.
Four soot-iron rocks around a heat vent. Tick-rotation with vent dodges. Competitive worlds only.
Deep coal gallery with 5-rock spacing. You AFK one rock, mine, walk three tiles, AFK the next. Easy, profitable, bank-heavy.
Four coal rocks at cardinal points around a player tile. 3-tick rotation yields ~720 coal/hr. Must rebank every 27 pulls — superb money.
A thin gold vein glowing faintly in the cemetery wall. Respawns slow enough to chat through. Mildly creepy atmosphere.

Pan mineral-rich sand through a sieve to recover gold shards, silver, and raw glass. Moderate attention due to sieve resets. Only gathering method that produces raw glass outside of Saltbrine crash-sites.
Wet crypt where silver condenses on the walls. Single rock, slow respawn, AFK-safe (ghosts nearby but are hard-passed).
Six mithril rocks in a hex, unlocked after completing the Gravechill Rite minor quest. Tick-rotated mithril. Players' best pre-70 XP.
Chip at weathered mineral heaps scoured out of old battlefields. Yields a lottery of tin/iron/coal/silver. No competition, deeply AFK.
Mixed gem node in a limestone quarry. Multitask AFK. Yields random gems — including 1/5000 dragonstone.
A row of three dense ruby gem rocks. Tick-swing rotation yields ~300 cut rubies/hr after processing.
Shimmering shard rocks in a grove. The trees politely heal you. Wildly AFK and pretty — the 'reading a book' method.
Four adamant rocks, one ruby gem rock rare-spawn. 3-tick rotation requires staring at respawn clocks.
Granite slabs baked by sun and spray. The slab weight matters (5kg / 10kg / 500g) — waterskin drain is real. Low gp/hr, high XP/hr.
Tap chips from a deep amethyst geode. Slow yield but each shard is a dartable/boltable treasure. High profit, low attention.
Lv18 Wilderness runite with a 12-minute respawn. You fight, you hide, you mine, you teleport. Extreme risk for extreme profit.
Sparse runite in a deep fold of the Wilds. PK risk is modest on dense worlds. AFK between cycles.
Blood-red gemstones bloom on cave walls. AFK gathering unlocked by a mid-game quest. Modest XP but unique gem output for crafting.
Reality is thin here. Voidstone phases in and out of the cliff. Click it only when visible. Magic-warded pickaxe required.
Four runite rocks in an instanced cave. Tick-perfect rotation + live-PvP exit corridor. The endgame mining chase.
A fallen star lands in the glade on a rotating timer. Ten minutes of intense multi-player gathering, shared XP, once-per-instance.
Smelt bronze bars. Starter training. Low burn.
Smelt bar + hammer dagger rotation. Ironman-grade pure XP.
Iron bar smelting with ~50% success without ring of forging. AFK-friendly if you use the ring (+40% success).
Iron-dagger smith-and-drop rotation. Ring of forging required.
Standard furnace smelt for soot-iron without blast. AFK.
Blast furnace halves coal requirement for steel+. Constant conveyor-feed attention. Peak 25+.
Steel bars via blast furnace. 60-sec conveyor cycles. Classic 30+ XP.
Steel platebodies in bulk. AFK-grade anvil hammering.
Gold bar smelting with goldsmith gauntlets. 2x XP per bar. AFK-Multitask.
Gold ring + amulet spam on 4 adjacent anvils. Tick-perfect withdraw-hammer.
Mithril bars at a moryskah furnace. AFK single-track smelting.
Mithril via blast. 60-sec cycle. Peak 50+ XP.
Adamant bars via blast.
Adamant 2h swords. AFK anvil for 70+.
Minigame-like sword commissioning. Multi-stage heat+quality management.
Rune scimitar bulk. AFK anvil for 65+.
Runite smelting at an abandoned Wilds forge. Paranoia baseline high.
Peak runite training. Full blast-conveyor cycle.
Forge the Blade of Soot. Multi-hammer sequence. Max XP in the game. Once-per-day cooldown.
Runite platebodies. AFK endgame anvil. Great profit.
Cannonball mould casting. Slowest Smithing XP but profit-leading. AFK.
Standard trees around Lumbrick. Press-once-a-minute tier.
Chop-and-drop rotation through the dense half of the grove. No banking, pure XP.
Classic scattered-oak AFK. Walk between spawns.
3-tick tea-drinking drop-chop on oak. Pure XP, requires constant herblore-tea input.
Charred stumps left over from old surface-fires. Slower than oak but yields heat-cured logs.
Tight 4-stump rotation. Watch for coalshards falling from the canopy.
Dense salt-willow cluster. Press-and-AFK until logs fill.
Power-chop every willow, drop every log. Best XP/hr 30-45. Brutal for shoulders.
Maples that glow faintly in half-real light. AFK-safe but you may lose track of time.
Three maples in a reality-bent triangle. Tick-rotation + lucid-tea = 30% XP boost.
Scattered teak trees on a planted estate. Walk between, AFK chop. The logs sell.
2-tick teak with dual lit-tinderbox cycle. The endgame XP method for 35-60. Requires firemaking.
Scattered yews in a hermit's glade. The hermits provide tea. Genuinely peaceful.
3-yew cluster on the docks. Dust-of-aggression from Saltbrine cats makes AFK mid-chop unsafe. Worth the XP.
Ancient magic trees. Slow respawn, high value. The pre-sleep-before-work training method.
4-tree magic row with axe-warp scrolls to teleport between them. Tick-perfect chop.
Ironwood trees. Slow, AFK, and the logs are used in endgame construction. Safer than magic.
Dreamwoods only exist when you whistle. Maintain the tune while chopping. Severe attention cost.
Redwoods in the Wilderness. Low PK risk but constantly watching. AFK with paranoia.
Instanced redwood stand with fast respawn. Tick-chop + log drop sequence. Best WC in Scape.
Petrified trees yield bone-wood logs for Moryskah construction. Slow, AFK, creepy.
Rotation through 3 petrified trees. Screamers in the trees add attention cost.
